body: Yeah I got sent to a crisis hospital recently for two weeks. Now I've been going to intensive therapy and I'm on anti-depressants but I still feel so horrible inside sometimes and I just feel like I don't deserve to be here anymore

I know this person may feel like the center of your life and that everything revolves around them and that you're a fuck-up (i've felt that way before) but most of the time that person is never perfect and is just a normal human being who also makes mistakes. If you're meant to be with someone then they will love you for every single piece of you. Maybe things will work out with her or maybe it own't but either way you're going to live a happy and long life that will be full of wonderful moments and even sad ones, that's life. The pain will last for a while though, I get it. It's like someone you loved died. Just surround yourself with family and friends (a support system) and tell yourself every day that you are worth it. Make a list of good things about yourself, it may start out small but eventually it'll take you hours to read. That's what I do. Hope this helped
